UCSF MedAI - MASS and MUSE volumetrics - ADNI 1-3

Source: R/data.R
MUSE_volume_ADNI123.Rd

UCSF MedAI - MASS and MUSE volumetrics - ADNI 1-3 data. More information is available at https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Usage

data(MUSE_volume_ADNI123)

Format

A data frame with 10329 observations and 273 variables.

Source

https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Details

  • PTID character Subject ID

  • EXAMDATE Date of scan Date: YYYY-MM-DD

  • LONI_UID numeric Image unique identifer Range value: 31863, ..., 1639219

  • LONI_SERIES numeric LONI Series ID Range value: 8723, ..., 1173525

  • LONI_STUDY numeric LONI Study ID Range value: 1945, ..., 218248
